annotation: Manual. Coordinates read off gridded, upscaled crops (crops/annot_*.png, minor grid 10 px, labels every 50 px) by the preflight stage, then checked on crops/check_*.png. tail_mid was placed with the help of a skeleton of the tail part of mask.png (arc-length midpoint between tail_base and tail_tip), then confirmed visually.
left_right: Cat's own left/right. Cat faces image-right with its RIGHT flank toward the camera; head turned to camera, so the cat's right ear/eye are image-left on the face. Near (right) legs are the image-left leg of each pair and sit lower in the frame (closer to camera): paw_FR is the image-left front paw, paw_HR the image-left hind paw. The far hind leg (HL) emerges from behind the belly.

ear_tip_R.note: apex of the image-left ear (cat's right), rounded tip, fur edge

ear_tip_L.note: apex of the image-right ear (cat's left), pointed tip

eye_R.note: pupil centre (vertical slit) of image-left eye

eye_L.note: pupil centre (vertical slit) of image-right eye

nose.note: centre of the pink nose pad (pad spans u 1120-1169, v 578-597)

paw_FR.note: image-left front paw; centre of ground footprint, placed ~10 px above the visible contact edge (v~1367), mid-width of toe row u 932-1040

paw_FL.note: image-right front paw (far side, higher in frame); footprint centre ~10 px above contact edge (v~1357), toe row u 1115-1222

paw_HR.note: image-left hind paw (near); footprint centre ~8 px above contact edge (v~1291), u 412-512

paw_HL.note: far hind paw, leg emerges from behind belly; footprint centre ~8 px above contact edge (v~1279), u 667-755

tail_base.note: centre of tail cross-section where it meets the rump outline (upper tail edge v~640, lower junction v~755 at u~485-500); soft fur junction

tail_mid.note: tail centreline at half arc length (total ~570 px tip->base along skeleton)

tail_tip.note: end of the tail along its centreline, just inside the fluffy tip outline (fur extremity v~360)

shoulder_R.note: estimated point of shoulder above the near (right) foreleg; not a visible edge

hip_R.note: estimated hip joint inside the near thigh/rump mass; not a visible edge

hock_HR.note: near hind leg hock, where the posterior leg outline bends (outline at u~398, v~1065)

chin.note: lowest point of the pale chin below the mouth (mouth at v~619)
